integrity_notes: Analytic proof with exact subgroup averaging, Stirling expansion, Schur complement and Cauchy determinant; supplementary exact rational and finite numerical checks were run. Neither prior exact formulas nor finite computations are represented as independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed dimension and monomial exponent vector, positive integer multiplicity, critical Dirichlet coefficient norm, and total-degree polynomial multiplier cutoff. Only the second-order harmonic-number penalty is proposed as new; leading critical law and finite Gram formula are known.
title: Universal logarithmic multiplicity penalty for cyclic monomial boundary zeros
